_: The words Database Services uses for the measurement. The method is in the scripts; this is the vocabulary. A value left out is reported as unavailable, with its reason, never defaulted to another team's.
label: Database Services

counts._: What counts as one delivered thing, and when it is delivered.

flow._: Where an item can sit, and what that means for flow.
flow._sprint_label_prefixes: How this board's sprint names are shortened on a chart axis. Longest match wins, so a specific prefix beats a general one. These are display prefixes and are deliberately NOT the pod prefixes: 'DS-' would also match 'DS-R9.00-S4' and strip it to nonsense.

reactive._: How this team marks work it did not plan. DS applies the label unevenly, which is why the report says so rather than publishing 0%.
